title: PR8423 Staging runtime attestation build-context contract alignment

phases.objective: Align every Staging runtime-artifact build-context consumer with the canonical .staging-build-context directory contract without weakening exact-main, signing, trusted-ingress, provider, database, or Production mutation boundaries.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Both host-side and GitHub-hosted runtime attestation derive the exact Git build context through a directory whose basename is .staging-build-context, while the existing exact-SHA identity and no-mutation boundaries remain unchanged.
steps: Create the host-side attestation build-context directory as <output>/.staging-build-context.
Create the GitHub-hosted attestation build-context directory as $RUNNER_TEMP/.staging-build-context.
Read .staging-build-context.json from the same canonical directory used by the generator.
Keep exact main SHA, tree, context digest, image digest, Gateway identity, trusted ingress, and signed attestation checks unchanged.
assertions: No runtime attestation path uses the legacy build-context or staging-runtime-build-context basename.
The generator fail-closed basename contract is preserved rather than weakened.
Live Staging certification remains required after merge.
No Production, provider, database, schema, grant, DNS, credential, or signing-authority mutation is introduced.
The PR declaration is registered exactly in Constitution.control_plane_paths and convergence.automation_control_paths.
